description: The absolute scan that scripts/census add and sync read baseline counts from, run from the repository root. It prints one `path:line: kind "value" (role)` line per offender. A person never types a count. Empty (the default): the scan is the engine's own literal census (literal_census.occurrences over config.literal_check_*, judged by literals.*), so add and sync work in the engine; a product declares its own scanner here (OU-DECOUPLE F5, D-113: the only declared scanner was the deleted product's).
